All three functions have been implemented and exported:

1. **formatBytes(n)** in src/util.js — converts byte counts to human-readable format (e.g., "1.5MB") with one decimal place
2. **slugify(title)** in src/text.js — converts titles to URL-safe slugs (lowercase, trim, space-to-dash, strips special characters)
3. **fetchUsers(baseUrl)** in src/api.js — fetches users from the API endpoint, logs the count, and returns the array
